title: Juicy Grilled Polish Tofu Kebabs
description: A festive Polish dish featuring herbal and creamy flavors with a char-grilled twist, perfect for plant-based diets, this recipe combines the brightness of orange blossom water with the savory depth of traditional Polish cuisine, all on a stick.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, orange blossom water, garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped parsley and dill to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated tofu onto the soaked wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the tofu is golden brown and slightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let them rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional parsley and dill if desired.
